newsitem.title: SPAIN: BCH says pact with Endesa intact.
newsitem.headline: BCH says pact with Endesa intact.

text.p: Jose Maria Amusategui, the chairman of Spanish bank Banco Central Hispano (BCH), said on Monday that ties between it and utility Empresa Nacional de Electricidad (Endesa) remained intact.
BCH owns 1.5 percent of Endesa and plans to raise its stake to 3.0 percent.
Speculation has arisen that ties between the two were troubled since they are competing to buy 60 percent of Retevision, which will be Spain's second telephone operator.
"The pact (with Endesa) isn't broken and no steps have been taken to break it," Amusategui told journalists.
"My desire is to remain open to all types of work with Endesa," Amusategui added.
